desc: Reddit said in its help-center change log that it has started a test letting users choose Hot, Top, Best, or New sorting in the Following feed.
X lowered the weight of share via copy link in the home-mixer weights mirror from 20.0 to 0.0. The vm-ranker mirror remains at 20.0.
Alibaba deployed ReSID, which fixes generative retrieval missing unpopular items, on its ads surface and reported a 1.3% increase in ad revenue in an A/B test.
X stopped applying the rules that drop DoNotAmplify and malicious-URL-label posts from recommendation surfaces to the author's followers.
